verdict.rationale: Stripe documents natural-language operation through AI agents rather than through its own built-in natural-language interface. Its MCP server gives agents tools to act on the Stripe API, Link CLI docs pair natural-language requests with agent purchases and spending questions, MPP integrations can be built from a single prompt to a coding agent, and buyers can complete purchases without leaving the conversation. The natural-language layer itself is the user's external agent, and spending and certain write actions require human approval outside the conversation. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language command interface, documented coverage of which product operations natural language can drive, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
